Curation.description: Human decisions about records, kept apart from what sources say. Every decision can carry a note.

site.description: Sampling site or block, used so validation never tests a record against its own site.

study.description: The paper or submission this record comes from. Defaults to the title on its source record.

originSource.description: The source of a reported origin, such as a paper's table. Required for `origin-reported`.

Id.description: Records are plain JSON: ISO date strings, no classes. See docs/architecture/data-schema.md.

ProvenanceClass.description: What is known about how an animal or specimen came to be sampled. `unknown` is a real value.

EvidenceUse.description: How a reference record may be used. Records assigned by sequence can never show where a group occurs.
